_doc.vehicle.mass: whole car including the driver, kg
_doc.vehicle.weight_front: fraction of the weight on the front axle
_doc.targets_file: optional shared team targets JSON, path relative to this design file
_doc.spring: optional block (null = not modeled); see spring_defaults
_doc.loads.pothole_g: impact: vertical load as a multiple of the static wheel load
_doc.loads.kerb_g: impact: sideways load on the wheel (pushing it inboard), multiple of the static load
_doc.loads.brake_split: 'bias': braking force shared by vehicle.front_brake_share; 'grip': Fx = g x Fz
_doc.loads.lltd_front: front lateral load transfer share; null = from the car's roll balance or the weight split
_doc.members.rod_end_rating: N, the rod end's catalog radial static (ultimate) rating; null = not checked
_doc.members.bolt_dia: mm, bolt through each rod end (7.94 = 5/16 in)
_doc.members.rod_end_k: N/mm, axial stiffness of one rod end (each link has two); an estimate
_doc.members.mount_k: N/mm, chassis tab or bracket at the inboard end of each link; an estimate
_doc.members.toe_comp_limit: deg, largest acceptable compliance toe change (cornering, braking, accel)
_doc.members.camber_comp_limit: deg, largest acceptable compliance camber change
_doc.spring.rocker_axis: direction of the rocker pivot bolt
_doc.spring.damper_bump_low: N per m/s at the shaft, from the damper dyno; also _high and rebound_low/_high
_doc.spring.damper_knee: mm/s shaft speed where low-speed turns into high-speed
_doc.sweep.bump_travel: mm of bump to check (null = travel); with droop_travel, for a car whose travel isn't symmetric
_doc.sweep.droop_travel: mm of droop to check (null = travel)
_doc.sweep.pack_heave_steps: heave positions searched for the tightest link clearance (x pack_rack_steps rack positions at the front)
_doc.wheel.rim_inner_radius: mm, radius of the inside of the rim barrel; null = rim radius - 15 mm (an estimate: measure your wheel)
_doc.wheel.caliper: optional brake caliper envelope: {clock_deg (0 = forward, 90 = top), radius (mm, axle to caliper center), size (mm, bounding diameter), offset (mm along the axle, + outboard)}
_doc.vehicle.aero_front: N of downforce on the front axle at your design speed (optional): reports sag and the ride frequency there
_doc.vehicle.aero_rear: N of downforce on the rear axle at your design speed (optional)
_doc.halfshaft: rear, optional: {diff_output: [x,y,z] inboard CV center, cv_outboard: [x,y,z] outboard CV center at ride height, cv_angle_max_in / cv_angle_max_out (deg), plunge_max (mm)}
_doc.members.rack_k: N/mm, steering rack and its mounts along the rack (front compliance; optional estimate)
_doc.members.column_k: N m/deg at the steering wheel, column torsion (needs vehicle.rack_c_factor; optional estimate)
_doc.clearance.halfshaft_od: mm, halfshaft tube OD for its clearance to the links
_doc.clearance.caliper_margin: mm, gap the caliper needs to the rim barrel and the links
_doc.members.rod_end_misalign: deg, the rod ends' catalog misalignment limit (each side of square); joints.<key>.allow overrides one joint
_doc.members.bearing_misalign: deg, the spherical bearings' (ball joints') catalog misalignment limit
_doc.joints: per-joint overrides keyed like the hardpoints and spring points: {"bolt": "x"|"y"|"z"|"pivot"|"kingpin"|"rocker"|[x, y, z], "square": true|false, "type": "rod_end"|"bearing", "allow": deg}

members.material: 4130 chromoly steel, normalized (yield is lower next to welds)
